tasks.label: Build MASM 32-bit
tasks.command: if (-not (Test-Path Debug)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Name Debug | Out-Null } ; foreach ($file in Get-ChildItem *.asm) { ml.exe /c /Zd /Zi /coff /I"C:\GitHub\irvine" /FoDebug\ $file.Name } ; if ($?) { link.exe /SUBSYSTEM:CONSOLE /DEBUG /MACHINE:X86 /LIBPATH:"C:\GitHub\irvine" Debug\*.obj Irvine32.lib kernel32.lib user32.lib /OUT:"Debug\${workspaceFolderBasename}.exe" }
